g.text: Structure and content only. Callout numbers are explained in docs/frontend.md. Grey = layout; dashed = shown only when relevant; example values only.
Screening tool: ranks where to look first. Candidate sites are simulated. Not a tree count or a carbon figure.
Notice strip (only when needed): MOCK data banner · scores.geojson problem · ML scores out of date · street tiles offline
Table order = API ranking (ML model when merged).
Moving a slider re-ranks in the browser
using the same formula as the API.
Offline OSM basemap + corridor (dashed orange) + sites coloured by score
Placeholder score: the ML model has not been merged yet.
Each score times its weight, in points of the total:
• Surroundings hotter than 76% of candidate sites
• Surroundings less green than 54% of sites
• 310 m of the 469 m of nearby path has no canopy
• Next to a gap in the approximate corridor (3 m)
Walking path within 50 m / without canopy
Distance to nearest corridor gap / park
Temperatures are for ranking sites against each
Limits of this data (list from /meta caveats): simulated sites, approximate corridor, ranking-grade temperature,
canopy is a proxy and independent maps disagree, no ground truth...
Attribution (from /meta): Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors · Copernicus Sentinel-2 · Landsat (USGS) · Google Earth Engine
Screening tool: ranks where to look first. Candidate sites are simulated. Not a tree count or a carbon figure.
Baseline 2021-10 to 2023-09 compared with Latest 2024-10 to 2026-09. Two-year windows.
synced map with NDVI or temperature overlay
synced map with NDVI or temperature overlay
Same colour scale on both maps. (Temperature: gap-filled, ranking-grade.)
Within the year-to-year swing of about 6 points. A vegetation proxy, not a tree count.
Different clear days and seasons; ranking, not exact values.
... five rows, then the series note (single years are noisy).
Do independent maps agree about canopy?
Estimates range from 4.4% to 27.7%, about 6 times apart, so canopy share is uncertain.
... six rows (4 reference rows + our proxy twice), then the caveat note.
Limits of this data (list from /meta caveats): simulated sites, approximate corridor, ranking-grade temperature,
canopy is a proxy and independent maps disagree, no ground truth...

States to design (all must stay honest and readable)
Full-page message: "The data service is not reachable", why, the exact start
command, and a Retry button. Main content hidden.
Red banner: invented MOCK data, do not present as Elmina results. Red chips.
Layer toggles that have no data are disabled.
Amber chip and a notice in the detail panel until the ML scores are merged
D. Score file problem or stale
Red notice with a generic message (scores_error) or "computed on older data"
